title: Breaking the Economy: How Climate Tail Risk and Financial Conditions can Shape Loss Persistence and Economic Recovery
title_zh: 打破经济：气候尾部风险与金融状况如何影响损失持续性与经济复苏
title_primary: 打破经济：气候尾部风险与金融状况如何影响损失持续性与经济复苏
title_secondary: Breaking the Economy: How Climate Tail Risk and Financial Conditions can Shape Loss Persistence and Economic Recovery
authors: Andrea Mazzocchetti, Irene Monasterolo, Nepomuk Dunz, Arthur Hrast Essenfelder
official: 官方在线 2025-06-18 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Acute physical risks are becoming more frequent and severe, with future scenarios projecting further intensification. Such events can cause significant and potentially persistent economic losses, and strain public finances due to increasing disaster response and recovery costs. However, so far, macroeconomic models have struggled to capture the impacts of climate physical risks in the economy and public finance in a consistent way. In particular, tail weather events and key shock transmission channels are often neglected, leading to a partial assessment of disaster losses and of the recovery needs. This information, in turn, is crucial to assess the climate insurance protection gap and to design adequate and financially sound public policy response. To address this gap, we tailor and extend EIRIN, a Stock-Flow Consistent macrofinancial model of an open economy, calibrated at the country level. EIRIN is composed of a limited number of heterogeneous agents and sectors of the real economy and finance, which interact through markets. Importantly, the real and the financial side of the economy are modelled in an integrated way. Agents are represented as a network of interconnected balance sheet items calibrated on real data, and are characterised by bounded rationality. This approach enables us to analyse the conditions for economic disruptions to emerge and become persistent, considering climate tail risk scenarios, and the role of fiscal and credit constraints as amplification mechanisms. We calibrate EIRIN on Italy, a country that is highly exposed to natural disasters, has significant fiscal vulnerabilities and high public debt. We find that extreme weather events leading to 15% of firms’ capital stock loss, coupled with subsequent financial constraints on lending, can trigger large and persistent adverse effects on GDP growth and public debt levels. Negative shocks are amplified in absence of country’s adaptation strategies and tailored financial policies.
abstract_zh: 急性物理风险正变得愈发频繁和严重，未来情景预测其将进一步加剧。此类事件可能造成重大且可能持续的经济损失，并因灾害应对和恢复成本上升而给公共财政带来压力。然而，迄今为止，宏观经济模型在一致性地捕捉气候物理风险对经济和公共财政的影响方面仍面临困难。特别是，尾部天气事件和关键冲击传导渠道往往被忽视，导致对灾害损失和恢复需求的评估不完整。而这些信息对于评估气候保险保障缺口以及设计充分且财政上稳健的公共政策应对至关重要。为弥补这一缺口，我们对EIRIN模型进行了定制和扩展，该模型是一个以国家层面校准的开放经济体存量-流量一致宏观金融模型。EIRIN由有限数量的异质性主体以及实体经济与金融部门构成，这些主体通过市场相互作用。重要的是，经济的实体面和金融面以一体化方式建模。主体以基于真实数据校准的互联资产负债表项目网络为代表，并具有有限理性特征。这一方法使我们能够分析经济扰动出现并持续的条件，考虑气候尾部风险情景，以及财政和信贷约束作为放大机制的作用。我们将EIRIN校准于意大利，该国高度暴露于自然灾害，具有显著的财政脆弱性和高公共债务。我们发现，极端天气事件导致企业资本存量损失15%，加之随后的金融信贷约束，可能对GDP增长和公共债务水平产生大规模且持续的负面影响。在缺乏国家适应战略和针对性金融政策的情况下，负面冲击会被放大。

title: Make Yourselves Scarce: The Effect of Demographic Change on the Relative Wages and Employment Rates of Experienced Workers
title_zh: 让自己变得稀缺：人口结构变化对经验丰富工人相对工资与就业率的影响
title_primary: 让自己变得稀缺：人口结构变化对经验丰富工人相对工资与就业率的影响
title_secondary: Make Yourselves Scarce: The Effect of Demographic Change on the Relative Wages and Employment Rates of Experienced Workers
authors: Michael Boehm, Christian Siegel, Daron Acemoglu, David Autor, Keelan Beirne 等
official: 官方在线 2021-03-23 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the impact of demographic change on experienced workers' relative wages and employment rates. We investigate empirical predictions from a framework of supply and demand for experience skill, using variation across U.S. local labor markets (LLMs) over the last decades and instrumenting experience skill supply by the LLMs' age structures a decade earlier. We find that aging substantially reduces experienced workers' relative wages and full-time employment rates, and also their labor market participation rates. Our results imply that the effect of demographic change on labor markets might be more severe than previously recognized, as it reaches beyond wages.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了人口结构变化对经验丰富工人相对工资和就业率的影响。我们利用美国地方劳动力市场（LLMs）过去几十年的变化，并借助这些市场十年前年龄结构作为经验技能供给的工具变量，检验了经验技能供需框架下的实证预测。研究发现，人口老龄化显著降低了经验丰富工人的相对工资和全职就业率，同时也降低了他们的劳动参与率。我们的结果表明，人口结构变化对劳动力市场的影响可能比先前认识到的更为严重，因为它超出了工资范畴。

title: Underrepresentation of Women CEOs
title_zh: 女性CEO代表性不足问题研究
title_primary: 女性CEO代表性不足问题研究
title_secondary: Underrepresentation of Women CEOs
authors: Li He, Toni M Whited
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Why do so few women become CEOs? To understand this glass ceiling, we estimate a dynamic model of the CEO gender decision, which contains perceived gender productivity differences, search costs reflecting limited female labor supply, and employer disutility from discrimination. The key factor is the shortage of suitable female candidates, as boards prefer hiring women, and productivity differences between genders are minimal. We find no evidence of a glass cliff in which women become CEOs just as firms are failing. While better governance is associated with women becoming CEOs, the importance of limited female labor supply is unrelated to governance.
abstract_zh: 为何女性CEO如此稀少？为探究这一“玻璃天花板”现象，我们构建了一个CEO性别决策的动态模型，该模型涵盖了感知到的性别生产力差异、反映女性劳动力供给有限的搜寻成本，以及雇主因歧视而产生的负效用。关键因素在于合适女性候选人的短缺，因为董事会倾向于聘用女性，且两性间的生产力差异微乎其微。我们未发现“玻璃悬崖”的证据，即女性在企业濒临失败之际出任CEO的情况。尽管更优的公司治理与女性出任CEO相关，但女性劳动力供给有限的重要性与治理无关。

title: Preferential trade agreements and non-tariff measures
title_zh: 优惠贸易协定与非关税措施
title_primary: 优惠贸易协定与非关税措施
title_secondary: Preferential trade agreements and non-tariff measures
authors: David J. Kuenzel, Rishi R. Sharma
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the product-level effects of Preferential Trade Agreements (PTAs) on the implementation of non-tariff measures (NTMs) using a global database spanning the 2000-2017 period. Employing an instrumental variable strategy, we provide evidence that an increase in the import share of PTA partners leads to a reduction in the application of NTMs. Exploring several mechanisms, we find that these effects are driven by products with higher preferential margins, the gap between MFN and preferential tariff rates. This result is consistent with what we call a “rent preservation effect,” whereby PTA partner countries push to limit the imposition of NTMs in order to preserve their preferential rents. We find that the negative PTA-NTM nexus is stronger for deeper PTAs, technical NTMs, and advanced economies. But there is no evidence that the effects are confined to NTMs that target broader or narrower sets of countries, agricultural products, or products that are subject to more NTMs. Importantly, higher PTA import shares contribute to multilateral liberalization by lowering both the usage of NTMs against PTA members and non-PTA partners.
abstract_zh: 我们利用覆盖2000-2017年期间的全球数据库，研究了特惠贸易协定（PTAs）对非关税措施（NTMs）实施的产品层面影响。采用工具变量策略，我们提供的证据表明，PTA伙伴国进口份额的增加会导致NTMs适用减少。通过探索多种机制，我们发现这些效应由具有较高特惠幅度（即最惠国税率与特惠税率之间的差距）的产品所驱动。这一结果与我们所谓的“租金保全效应”相一致，即PTA伙伴国推动限制NTMs的施加，以维护其特惠租金。我们发现，PTA与NTM之间的负向关联在更深层次的PTA、技术性NTMs以及发达经济体中更为显著。但没有证据表明这些效应仅限于针对更广泛或更狭窄国家群体、农产品或受更多NTMs约束的产品。重要的是，较高的PTA进口份额通过降低对PTA成员国及非PTA伙伴国的NTMs使用，促进了多边自由化。

title: Consumer Loans, Heterogeneous Interest Rates, and Inequality
title_zh: 消费贷款、异质性利率与不平等
title_primary: 消费贷款、异质性利率与不平等
title_secondary: Consumer Loans, Heterogeneous Interest Rates, and Inequality
authors: Marco Bonomo, Tiago Cavalcanti, Fernando Chertman, Amanda Fantinatti, Andrew Hannon 等
official: 官方在线 2025-03-24 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine this question empirically and quantitatively, using Brazilian credit registry and matched employer-employee data. Low-income individuals face higher interest rates, even after controlling for several risk factors and characteristics. Our model includes life-cycle dynamics, different credit types, occupations, and income shocks with endogenous default. According to the calibrated model, reforms reducing loan interest rate spreads could significantly benefit individuals, especially young and poor informal workers. The pro-competition 2013 Loan Portability reform increased welfare by 0.2% of annual consumption.
abstract_zh: 我们利用巴西信贷登记数据及匹配的雇主-雇员数据，对此问题进行了实证与定量研究。即便在控制多种风险因素和特征后，低收入个体仍面临更高的利率。我们的模型涵盖了生命周期动态、不同信贷类型、职业以及带有内生违约的收入冲击。根据校准模型，降低贷款利率利差的改革能显著惠及个体，尤其是年轻且贫困的非正规部门工人。2013年促进竞争的贷款可携性改革使年度消费福利提升了0.2%。

title: Monetary Policy in the News: Communication Pass-Through and Inflation Expectations
title_zh: 新闻中的货币政策：沟通传导与通胀预期
title_primary: 新闻中的货币政策：沟通传导与通胀预期
title_secondary: Monetary Policy in the News: Communication Pass-Through and Inflation Expectations
authors: Fiorella De Fiore, Alexis Maurin, Andrej Mijakovic, Damiano Sandri
official: 官方在线 2024-12-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We analyse the media’s role in channelling information about the Fed’s monetary policy stance to the public. Using LLMs, we find a tight correspondence between FOMC communication and media coverage, although with significant variation over time. The communication pass-through weakened during the ZLB period and improved with the introduction of press conferences, which now exert strong influence on the media. Media coverage effects households' inflation expectations, particularly when inflation is high and volatile, while we do not detect a direct impact of FOMC communication. This underscores the media’s crucial function in channelling central banks’ communication to the public.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了媒体在向公众传递美联储货币政策立场信息中所扮演的角色。利用大型语言模型，我们发现联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）的沟通与媒体报道之间存在紧密对应关系，尽管随时间存在显著变化。沟通传导在零利率下限（ZLB）时期有所减弱，并随着新闻发布会制度的引入而改善，后者如今对媒体产生强烈影响。媒体报道影响家庭的通胀预期，尤其是在通胀高企且波动较大时，而我们未检测到FOMC沟通的直接影响。这凸显了媒体在将央行沟通传导至公众中的关键作用。

title: The anatomy of job polarisation: Evidence from four decades of French worker flows
title_zh: 工作两极化的解剖：来自法国工人流动四十年数据的证据
title_primary: 工作两极化的解剖：来自法国工人流动四十年数据的证据
title_secondary: The anatomy of job polarisation: Evidence from four decades of French worker flows
authors: Fabio Cerina, Elisa Dienesch, Alexander Monge-Naranjo, Alessio Moro
official: 官方在线 2026-08-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Employment polarisation – the decline of middle-skill routine occupations relative to both ends of the skill distribution – is usually documented from repeated cross-sections. However, the time evolution of cross-sections is driven by workers’ flows across occupational categories and in and out of the labour market. Drawing on an administrative panel that follows French workers over 1984–2021, this column shows that polarisation emerged through a collapse in entry into routine jobs from non-employment, not through displacement of incumbent routine workers. The findings redirect policy attention from protecting existing jobs towards the entry margin.
abstract_zh: 就业极化——即中等技能常规职业相对于技能分布两端的衰退——通常通过重复截面数据加以记录。然而，截面的时间演变是由工人在职业类别间的流动以及进出劳动力市场的动态所驱动的。基于追踪法国工人1984年至2021年情况的行政面板数据，本专栏表明，极化现象源于非就业状态进入常规职业的通道崩溃，而非现有常规工人的被迫转移。研究结果将政策关注点从保护现有就业转向进入环节。

title: Information Provision and Pesticide Reduction in Rice Production: Experimental Evidence From China
title_zh: 水稻生产中信息提供与农药减量：来自中国的实验证据
title_primary: 水稻生产中信息提供与农药减量：来自中国的实验证据
title_secondary: Information Provision and Pesticide Reduction in Rice Production: Experimental Evidence From China
authors: Chao Zhang, Qianqian Chen, Ruifa Hu
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using three waves of household data from a randomised controlled trial involving 676 rice farmers in Hubei and Jiangxi provinces of China over the period 2017–2019, we estimate the causal effect of information provision on pesticide use and examine heterogeneity with respect to the duration of the intervention, farmers' human capital, and the identity and mode of information providers. The results reveal that 1 year of information provision did not reduce pesticide use intensity, whereas 2 years of provision led to a substantial reduction of 47.2%. This finding remains robust to alternative pesticide measures, sample winsorization, and different regional fixed effects specifications. The pesticide reduction effect is larger among farmers with higher levels of human capital. Information provided by government extension agents significantly reduces pesticide use, particularly when provided through face‐to‐face farmer training and retailer‐mediated dissemination. In contrast, identical information provided by pesticide firms has no significant effect, regardless of the intervention duration or provision mode. Moreover, the provision of pesticide‐reduction information lowers health risks for farmers and environmental risks to ecosystems from toxic exposure without compromising rice yield. These findings imply that future policies should prioritise sustained information provision targeting smallholders, strengthen intervention effectiveness for farmers with lower human capital, and enhance government extension services.
abstract_zh: 利用2017至2019年间针对中国湖北和江西两省676名稻农的三轮家庭调查数据，我们评估了信息提供对农药使用的因果效应，并考察了干预持续时间、农民人力资本以及信息提供者身份和方式等方面的异质性。结果显示，为期一年的信息提供并未降低农药使用强度，而两年的信息提供则显著减少了47.2%的农药使用量。这一发现在不同农药衡量指标、样本缩尾处理及不同区域固定效应设定下均保持稳健。人力资本水平较高的农民，其农药减量效果更为显著。政府推广人员提供的信息能显著减少农药使用，尤其是通过面对面的农民培训和零售商中介传播时效果更佳。相比之下，农药企业提供的相同信息无论干预时长或提供方式如何，均无显著效果。此外，提供减药信息降低了农民的健康风险及生态系统因有毒物质暴露所面临的环境风险，且未影响水稻产量。这些发现表明，未来政策应优先考虑面向小农户的持续信息供给，加强对人力资本较低农民的干预效果，并强化政府推广服务。

title: Estimating grain storage with probate inventories: Kent and Cornwall, 1600-1750
title_zh: 利用遗嘱清单估算粮食储存量：肯特郡与康沃尔郡，1600-1750年
title_primary: 利用遗嘱清单估算粮食储存量：肯特郡与康沃尔郡，1600-1750年
title_secondary: Estimating grain storage with probate inventories: Kent and Cornwall, 1600-1750
authors: L. Brunt, E. Cannonm
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We show how probate inventories can be used to measure the seasonal pattern of grain stocks and hence provide direct information on both intra-year and inter-year storage (“carryover”). The correct procedure to quantify total carryover is a ratio-of-means statistic that consistently estimates the appropriate weighted average of individual carryover decisions. Using an existing data base of inventories, we show that the seasonal pattern is plausible, robust to alternative specifications and consistent with an alternative way of estimating carryover. We find that average carryover in the period 1600-1750 was very low in Kent and virtually zero in Cornwall.
abstract_zh: 我们展示了如何利用遗嘱认证清单来衡量谷物库存的季节性模式，从而直接提供年内和跨年储存（“结转”）的信息。量化总结转的正确方法是采用均值比统计量，该统计量能一致地估计个体结转决策的适当加权平均值。利用现有的清单数据库，我们表明季节性模式是合理的，对替代规格具有稳健性，并与估算结转的另一种方法相一致。我们发现，在1600年至1750年间，肯特郡的平均结转量非常低，而康沃尔郡几乎为零。

title: Why Is Fertility So Low in High-Income Countries?
title_zh: 为什么高收入国家生育率如此之低？
title_primary: 为什么高收入国家生育率如此之低？
title_secondary: Why Is Fertility So Low in High-Income Countries?
authors: Kearney, Melissa S., Levine, Phillip B.
official: 卷期日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We consider why fertility has fallen in recent decades in almost all high-income countries. We begin by documenting declining total fertility and rising childlessness across cohorts, highlighting the need to focus on cohort versus period-specific fertility rates. With this motivation, we propose a conceptual model of fertility determination that augments the standard Becker model with an explicit role for social norms and cohort-specific contextual factors, including broad social and economic influences and an expanded set of consumption and lifestyle options. We posit that these forces have led to “shifting priorities,” reducing the centrality of parenthood. We then review existing empirical evidence –and conclude that the decline in fertility likely reflects a complex mix of changing norms around work, parenting, gender roles, and leisure consistent with our cohort-based conceptual framework. We conclude with suggestions for future research and a brief discussion of policy implications.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了近几十年来几乎所有高收入国家生育率下降的原因。我们首先记录了不同世代群体中总和生育率的下降及无子女现象的上升，强调需关注世代特定生育率而非时期特定生育率。基于此，我们提出一个生育决定的概念模型，该模型在标准贝克尔模型基础上，引入社会规范与世代特定情境因素（包括广泛的社会经济影响及扩大的消费与生活方式选择）的显性作用。我们假设这些力量导致了“优先事项的转变”，削弱了为人父母的核心地位。随后，我们回顾现有实证证据，并得出结论：生育率下降可能反映了围绕工作、育儿、性别角色及休闲的规范变迁的复杂组合，这与我们基于世代的概念框架一致。最后，我们提出未来研究建议并简要讨论政策启示。

title: Institutional Shocks and Migration Adjustment: Evidence from the Syrian Crisis and Brexit’s Referendum and Implementation
title_zh: 制度冲击与移民调整：来自叙利亚危机及英国脱欧公投与实施的证据
title_primary: 制度冲击与移民调整：来自叙利亚危机及英国脱欧公投与实施的证据
title_secondary: Institutional Shocks and Migration Adjustment: Evidence from the Syrian Crisis and Brexit’s Referendum and Implementation
authors: Assaf Razin
official: 官方在线 2026-03-06 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper interprets Brexit as a two-stage institutional rupture that reshaped migration through expectations, exposure, and stress channels. Using a UK–Germany Difference-in-Differences framework, I show that the 2016 referendum generated a sharp decline in UK net migration relative to Germany, driven primarily by a contraction in immigration rather than simple outward flight. The 2021 termination of EU free movement reinforced this adjustment on the gross inflow margin, completing the structural reallocation of mobility flows. Migration responses were not uniform: countries more deeply integrated into EU mobility networks prior to 2016 experienced significantly stronger contractions, confirming that Brexit propagated along pre-existing exposure channels. Embedding macro-financial stress interactions reveals that institutional fragility amplified the referendum shock, particularly during the expectations phase. Stress intensified migration contractions in exposed settings in 2016, while post-2021 responses became more heterogeneous, especially on the emigration margin. Together, the results support a sequential interpretation: an anticipatory expectations shock in 2016 followed by regime completion in 2021. Beyond short-run behavioral adjustments, the findings are consistent with the fiscal self-selection framework. Increases in perceived institutional risk alter the relative returns to skill and investment, reshaping both the composition of migration and foreign direct investment. Because skilled labor and FDI are complementary, institutional credibility shocks can generate self-reinforcing declines in human capital inflows and investment. Brexit therefore emerges not merely as a trade or regulatory event, but as an institutional credibility shock in which migration operates both as an outcome and as a transmission mechanism linking regime change to long-run growth dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本文将英国脱欧解读为一个两阶段的制度性断裂，通过预期、暴露和压力渠道重塑了移民格局。利用英德双重差分框架，本文表明2016年公投导致英国净移民相对于德国急剧下降，这主要源于移民流入的收缩，而非简单的向外逃离。2021年欧盟自由流动的终止强化了总流入边际上的这一调整，完成了流动性流动的结构性再配置。移民反应并非均匀一致：在2016年前更深度融入欧盟流动性网络的国家经历了显著更强的收缩，这证实了英国脱欧沿着既有的暴露渠道传播。嵌入宏观金融压力交互作用后发现，制度脆弱性放大了公投冲击，尤其是在预期阶段。2016年，压力加剧了暴露环境中的移民收缩，而2021年后的反应则变得更加异质，尤其是在迁出边际上。综合来看，这些结果支持一种序列性解释：2016年的预期性预期冲击，随后是2021年的制度完成。除了短期行为调整外，这些发现与财政自选择框架一致。感知到的制度风险上升改变了技能和投资的相对回报，从而重塑了移民构成和外国直接投资。由于熟练劳动力与外国直接投资具有互补性，制度可信度冲击可能引发人力资本流入和投资的自我强化式下降。因此，英国脱欧不仅是一个贸易或监管事件，更是一个制度可信度冲击，其中移民既是结果，也是连接制度变迁与长期增长动态的传导机制。

title: Why care about who pays for care? Horizontal inequity in home care use for older adults
title_zh: 为何关心谁为照护买单？老年人居家照护使用的横向不公平
title_primary: 为何关心谁为照护买单？老年人居家照护使用的横向不公平
title_secondary: Why care about who pays for care? Horizontal inequity in home care use for older adults
authors: Elsa Perdrix, Clémentine Garrouste, Florence Jusot
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: As populations age, a growing number of people need help with everyday activities. Long-term care can be provided by professional caregivers; however, the associated costs can lead to horizontal inequity, i.e. unequal access to care for individuals with similar needs. This paper examines income-related horizontal inequity in home care use in France, and the effects on horizontal inequity of the three funding systems involved: national health insurance, government allowances, and income tax deductions. Results reveal income-related inequities that favour wealthier individuals. Furthermore, while all three systems (including national health insurance) lead to horizontal inequity, we find that half of this inequity comes from home care provided by professionals funded directly by income tax deductions.
abstract_zh: 随着人口老龄化，越来越多的人需要在日常生活中获得帮助。长期护理可由专业护理人员提供，但相关成本可能导致横向不公平，即需求相似的个体在获取护理服务方面存在不平等。本文研究了法国家庭护理使用中与收入相关的横向不公平现象，并分析了三种相关资助体系——国家医疗保险、政府补贴和所得税减免——对横向不公平的影响。结果显示存在有利于富裕人群的收入相关不公平现象。此外，尽管这三种体系（包括国家医疗保险）均导致横向不公平，但我们发现其中一半的不公平源于由所得税减免直接资助的专业家庭护理服务。

title: Unpacking the compactness-emission nexus with the moderating role of environmental governance: Evidence from urban built-up areas in eastern China

title_primary: 环境治理调节下的紧凑度-排放关系解析：来自中国东部城市建成区的证据
title_secondary: Unpacking the compactness-emission nexus with the moderating role of environmental governance: Evidence from urban built-up areas in eastern China
authors: Yating Wang, Mengqiao Song, Jie Wang, Li He, Yecui Hu
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Compact development and low-carbon development in urban areas are critical pathways to tackle the problems concerning urban sprawl and climate change, which are pivotal for fostering and achieving urban sustainability. However, whether pursuing urban compactness constrains the realization of low-carbon goals remains to be elucidated. Accordingly, this study investigates the compactness-emission nexus and possible strategies for synchronizing compact urban development with carbon reduction. Using a city-level panel dataset covering 84 cities in eastern China over nine observed years in 2012–2022, the study first measures urban compactness through land use intensity, population density and land use mix; carbon emissions are measured by per unit built-up area carbon emission (UCE) and per capita carbon emissions (PCE). Then, the study employs panel regression models to analyze their relationships and the moderating role of environmental governance. Conclusions are majorly threefold. Firstly, the degree of urban compactness in eastern Chinese cities has increased over the past decade. Secondly, different dimensions of urban compactness have varying impacts on carbon emissions. Population density exhibits a significant negative effect on both UCE and PCE, while the growing land use intensity significantly elevates carbon emissions. Thirdly, environmental governance plays a significant moderating role in strengthening the impact of population density on carbon emission mitigation. With high governance intensity, the marginal effect of population density on UCE reverses from + 0.37 to –1.25, while its negative effect on PCE is further reinforced from –0.46 to –12.83. These findings offer policy-relevant insights for high-density cities in eastern China and, more broadly, for developing cities to confront the climate-urbanization challenge and sustainability transition pressures.
abstract_zh: 城市紧凑发展与低碳发展是应对城市蔓延和气候变化问题的关键路径，对于促进和实现城市可持续性至关重要。然而，追求城市紧凑度是否会制约低碳目标的实现，这一问题尚待阐明。据此，本研究探讨了紧凑度与碳排放之间的关系，以及实现紧凑城市发展与碳减排同步的可能策略。利用涵盖2012-2022年间九个观测年份、中国东部84个城市的市级面板数据集，本研究首先通过土地利用强度、人口密度和土地利用混合度来衡量城市紧凑度；碳排放则以单位建成区面积碳排放（UCE）和人均碳排放（PCE）来衡量。随后，研究采用面板回归模型分析它们之间的关系以及环境治理的调节作用。主要结论有三点。第一，过去十年间，中国东部城市的紧凑度有所提升。第二，城市紧凑度的不同维度对碳排放的影响各异。人口密度对UCE和PCE均呈现显著的负向效应，而土地利用强度的增加则显著推高了碳排放。第三，环境治理在强化人口密度对碳减排的影响方面发挥着显著的调节作用。在高治理强度下，人口密度对UCE的边际效应从+0.37逆转为-1.25，而其对PCE的负向效应则从-0.46进一步增强至-12.83。这些发现为中国东部高密度城市，乃至更广泛的发展中城市应对气候-城市化挑战及可持续转型压力提供了具有政策参考价值的见解。

title: Persistent global growth differences and euro area adjustment: Real activity, trade and the real exchange rate
title_zh: 全球增长差异的持续性与欧元区调整：实际经济活动、贸易与实际汇率

authors: Adrian Ifrim, Robert Kollmann, Philipp Pfeiffer, Marco Ratto, Werner Roeger

abstract: Since the launch of the euro, the Euro Area has combined weak growth with persistent trade surpluses, a rising trade share, and the absence of a real exchange rate trend. In academic and policy debates, the Euro Area's trade surplus is often viewed as reflecting weak domestic aggregate demand. This paper argues that a purely demand-based view of the trade balance is incomplete. Using an estimated two-region framework, we find that slower productivity growth in the Euro Area has been a major driver of the trade surplus since 1999, while demand shocks play an important role in the rising trade balance following the global financial crisis. We further show that real exchange rate dynamics cannot be understood from productivity growth differentials and aggregate demand shocks alone, but also reflect longer-run shifts in trade patterns.
abstract_zh: 自欧元启动以来，欧元区在经济增长疲软的同时，持续出现贸易顺差、贸易份额上升以及实际汇率无趋势的现象。在学术与政策讨论中，欧元区的贸易顺差常被视为国内总需求疲软的反映。本文认为，纯粹基于需求的贸易余额观点并不完整。通过使用一个估计的两区域框架，我们发现，自1999年以来，欧元区生产率增长放缓是贸易顺差的主要驱动因素，而需求冲击在全球金融危机后贸易余额上升中扮演了重要角色。我们进一步表明，实际汇率动态无法仅从生产率增长差异和总需求冲击来理解，还反映了贸易模式的长期转变。

authors: Alessandro Maravalle & Elena Vidal Muñoz

abstract: This paper develops a framework to evaluate the potential economic gains from deeper participation in global value chains (GVCs). The approach combines measures of revealed comparative advantage with estimates of value-added distribution along GVCs to identify opportunities for upgrading into higher–value-added production stages. It then quantifies the long-term economic effects of such upgrading using a structural gravity model. The framework is applied to Costa Rica’s electronics sector, a key focus of the country’s strategy to expand its role in the semiconductor value chain. The findings indicate that strengthening Costa Rica’s position within the electronics GVC could lead to substantial long-term increases in exports, output, and real wages.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个评估深度参与全球价值链（GVCs）潜在经济收益的分析框架。该框架将显性比较优势指标与全球价值链中增加值分布的估算相结合，以识别向更高附加值生产阶段升级的机遇，进而运用结构引力模型量化此类升级的长期经济效应。将该框架应用于哥斯达黎加电子行业——该国扩大半导体价值链参与战略的核心领域，研究结果表明：强化哥斯达黎加在电子全球价值链中的地位，可带来出口、产出与实际工资的长期显著增长。

title: Conservation outcomes across protected area strategies: Insights from a longitudinal analysis of the Brazilian National System of Conservation Units

authors: Clarisse Carmo, Alberto Fonseca

abstract: Assessing land use and land cover dynamics in protected areas (PA) is fundamental to understanding how different conservation strategies influence outcomes across distinct territorial contexts. The present study provided one of the most comprehensive longitudinal assessments of the PAs under the Brazilian System of Nature Conservation Units, through geospatial statistical analysis of land use and cover variations between 1985 and 2022, drawing on an ad hoc Natural Cover Dynamics Index (NCDI). The results revealed persistent conversion of natural areas within Brazilian PAs, including strictly protected categories, with agricultural expansion emerging as the main driver of natural cover loss. Findings also indicated differences in conservation performance among PA categories, reinforcing broader theoretical and political debates around forest transition theory and land sparing versus land sharing strategies. Beyond providing large-scale empirical evidence on conservation outcomes in Brazil, the analytical framework developed in this study contributes to policy-oriented assessments aimed at improving strategic conservation planning and the effectiveness of protected area system. abstract_zh: 评估保护区（PA）的土地利用与土地覆盖动态变化，对于理解不同保护策略如何在特定地域背景下影响保护成效至关重要。本研究基于1985年至2022年间土地利用与覆盖变化的时空统计分析，并借助特设的自然覆盖动态指数（NCDI），对巴西国家自然保护单位体系下的保护区进行了最为全面的纵向评估之一。结果显示，巴西保护区内（包括严格保护类别）的自然区域持续被转化，农业扩张成为自然覆盖丧失的主要驱动因素。研究还发现不同保护区类别在保护绩效上存在差异，这进一步强化了围绕森林转型理论以及土地节约与土地共享策略的广泛理论与政策辩论。除为巴西保护成效提供大规模实证证据外，本研究构建的分析框架还有助于开展面向政策导向的评估，旨在优化战略性保护规划并提升保护区体系的有效性。

title_zh: 飓风、气候变化政策与选举问责

authors: Gagliarducci, Stefano, Paserman, M. Daniele, Patacchini, Eleonora
official: 卷期日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the conditions under which legislators promote policies that may be unpopular in the short term but yield long-term benefits. Using data on the universe of federal disaster declarations from 1989 to 2020, we document that representatives from congressional districts impacted by hurricanes are more inclined to support environmental legislation addressing climate change. However, this response depends on political circumstances: only those in safe seats can change their political agenda towards policies that involve short-term costs for long-term gains. These results highlight the role of electoral incentives in shaping politicians’ attitudes towards far-sighted policy making.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了立法者在何种条件下会推动短期内可能不受欢迎但能带来长期利益的政策。利用1989年至2020年联邦灾害声明的全样本数据，我们发现，受飓风影响的国会选区代表更倾向于支持应对气候变化的环境立法。然而，这种反应取决于政治环境：只有处于安全席位的代表才能将政治议程转向涉及短期成本但带来长期收益的政策。这些结果凸显了选举激励在塑造政治家对远见政策制定态度中的作用。

abstract: Traditionally, fund managers cast votes on behalf of fund investors. Recently, there is a shift toward “pass-through voting,” with funds offering investors a choice: delegate votes to the fund or vote themselves. We develop a framework to study the implications of voting choice. While it helps reflect heterogeneous investor preferences, it also shapes the informational content of the vote, and these forces can conflict. When interests are aligned, voting choice improves information aggregation and investor welfare. abstract_zh: 摘要 传统上，基金经理代表基金投资者行使投票权。近期出现向“穿透式投票”的转变，基金为投资者提供选择：将投票权委托给基金或自行投票。我们构建了一个分析框架研究投票选择的影响。虽然投票选择有助于反映异质性投资者偏好，但也会塑造投票的信息含量，这两种力量可能相互冲突。当利益一致时，投票选择能改善信息聚合与投资者福利。然而，在偏好异质性或信息成本存在的情况下，投票选择可能因削弱知情投票而降低投资者福利。（JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, K22）

abstract: Urban development is perceived as an indicator of economic advancement and opportunity. However, rapid BUA expansion exerts land pressure, acting as a catalyst for land-use and land-cover (LULC) changes. This study examined the role of socio-environmental factors, including landscape types (LTs), geomorphology and topography, in BUA dynamics and LULC changes across urban, peri-urban and rural areas between 1842 and 2019. The spatial analysis for sixty randomly selected study sites (a total of 24,000 ha), located in the Central European region, employed ArcGIS tools, integrating historical cadastral maps (Stable Cadastre, 1842) with CORINE LULC data (2019), and statistical techniques, including Binomial Logistic Regression. Findings revealed that total BUA increased by 84.7%, mainly in warm lowlands, primarily replacing arable land (67.23% of the total LULC changes). The built-up growth encompassed a mixed-sized building ranging from 4 to 32,488 m 2 per unit through infill and edge expansion in urban areas (100–500 m distance from the historical built‑up fabric), and small-sized, clustered (0–50 m distance) BUA expansion around rural settlement cores. The Hot Spot Analysis (Getis-Ord Gi*) of recent BUA shows predominant clustering of large-sized buildings in the lowlands, which together account for 33.15%. Population density across 4–11 categories emerged as the most influential predictor. The study demonstrated that the socio-ecological factors act as opportunities (uniform topography of warm lowlands) and constraints (complex topography of cold highlands) for BUA expansion. From a land‑use policy perspective, the study prioritises spatially adaptive, ecologically integrated land‑use governance and restoration strategies in response to accelerating socio‑environmental change.
abstract_zh: 城市发展被视为经济进步与机遇的指标。然而，建成区（BUA）的快速扩张对土地造成压力，成为土地利用与土地覆盖（LULC）变化的催化剂。本研究考察了1842年至2019年间，包括景观类型（LTs）、地貌与地形在内的社会-环境因素在城市、城郊及农村地区的BUA动态与LULC变化中的作用。研究选取中欧地区60个随机样点（总面积24,000公顷），运用ArcGIS工具整合历史地籍图（1842年稳定地籍图）与CORINE LULC数据（2019年），并结合二项逻辑回归等统计方法进行分析。结果显示，BUA总面积增长84.7%，主要集中于温暖低地，其中耕地被替代占LULC总变化的67.23%。建成区扩张包含混合规模建筑（单体面积4至32,488平方米），通过城市区域（距历史建成区100–500米）的填充与边缘扩展，以及农村聚落核心周边小规模、集群式（0–50米距离）BUA扩张实现。近期BUA的热点分析（Getis-Ord Gi*）显示，大型建筑主要聚集于低地，占比达33.15%。人口密度（4–11个类别）成为最具影响力的预测因子。研究表明，社会-生态因素既构成BUA扩张的机遇（温暖低地均匀地形），也形成制约（寒冷高地复杂地形）。从土地利用政策视角，本研究优先提出空间适应性、生态整合的土地利用治理与恢复策略，以应对加速的社会-环境变化。

abstract: This paper investigates how lenders' costs of funds affect agricultural loan interest rates. We use a matched sample of US farm‐loan data and lender‐specific cost of funds, and a farm fixed effects design, to estimate pass‐through, conditioning on borrower characteristics. abstract: This paper provides novel evidence on the key drivers of job satisfaction. We ask individuals to describe, in their own words, what they like and dislike about their jobs. abstract: We study age-income gaps across 32 countries over 2004–2018 using harmonized microdata from the Luxembourg Income Study. We document a striking divergence: the ratio of disposable income of late-career workers (aged 55–64) relative to early-career workers (aged 25–34), which we name the Age Group Income Ratio (AGIR), rose by 18 percentage points in rich countries but fell by 8 percentage points in poor economies. This divergence operates primarily through the employment margin, which accounts for two-thirds of rising AGIR in rich countries and that conventional age-earnings measures miss entirely. To explain these patterns, we develop an overlapping generations model that discriminates among six competing mechanisms. In rich countries, skill congestion – late-career cohorts catching up with early-career workers in educational attainment and crowding them out of skilled labour markets – is the dominant driver of both margins. In poor countries, productivity growth dominates and skill congestion reduces rather than raises income inequality, as the young are expanding their college attainment more rapidly than the old.

abstract: Governments increasingly use pilot experimentation before national policy rollouts, but this strategy introduces policy uncertainty until reforms are permanently institutionalized. We study how resolving this uncertainty affects asset prices, exploiting China’s 2020 revision of the Land Management Law, which elevated previously experimental rural land reform pilots into a binding national legal framework. Using difference-in-differences estimates on land transactions in Deqing County from 2015 to 2022, we find that legal institutionalization increased rural construction land prices by 12.3%. This effect emerged immediately after institutionalization and gradually faded, consistent with belief updating and supply adjustment. Heterogeneity analysis supports the credible commitment channel: markets with greater state-owned enterprise (SOE) participation during the pilot phase show smaller effects, as state-owned enterprises’ privileged access to policy information had already driven prices toward uncertainty-free levels; and industrial land with 50-year tenure responds more strongly than commercial land with 40-year tenure, reflecting greater renewal risk exposure under shorter contracts. These findings highlight the asset-pricing costs of policy uncertainty and the value of credible commitment in transition economies.
abstract_zh: 各国政府在推行全国性政策之前，越来越多地采用试点实验的方式，但这一策略在改革永久制度化之前引入了政策不确定性。我们研究了消除这种不确定性如何影响资产价格，利用中国2020年《土地管理法》修订作为自然实验，该修订将此前实验性的农村土地改革试点提升为具有约束力的国家法律框架。通过对德清县2015年至2022年土地交易的差分估计，我们发现法律制度化使农村建设用地价格提高了12.3%。这一效应在制度化后立即显现并逐渐消退，与信念更新和供给调整相一致。异质性分析支持可信承诺渠道：试点阶段国有企业参与度较高的市场效应较小，因为国有企业获取政策信息的特权渠道已使价格趋近于无不确定性水平；此外，50年产权的工业用地比40年产权的商业用地反应更为强烈，反映出较短合同期限下更大的续期风险敞口。这些发现凸显了政策不确定性的资产定价成本以及转型经济中可信承诺的价值。

abstract: Business dynamism -- the process of firm entry, growth and exit -- lies at the heart of modern endogenous growth models. While productivity differences have traditionally been seen as the main driving forces of business dynamism, a growing body of evidence suggests that customer acquisition is at least as important. In light of this evidence, we propose a novel endogenous growth model in which innovating firms must first acquire customers to sell their products. Estimating our model with aggregate and firm-level data, we find that expansions of firms' customer bases (market sizes) boost their incentives to innovate and shift resources towards high-growth businesses (“gazelles”). Combined, these effects explain over 40% of aggregate growth and substantially change predictions about the efficacy of growth policies. Finally, we document support for key model predictions using firm-level micro-data.

title: The True Value of, the Value of a Statistical Life (VSL), in Benefit-Cost Analysis: How Might the VSL Be Different from What We Have Been Told?
title_zh: 效益成本分析中统计生命价值（VSL）的真实价值：VSL与我们被告知的可能有何不同？
title_primary: 效益成本分析中统计生命价值（VSL）的真实价值：VSL与我们被告知的可能有何不同？
title_secondary: The True Value of, the Value of a Statistical Life (VSL), in Benefit-Cost Analysis: How Might the VSL Be Different from What We Have Been Told?
authors: Payson, Steven, Dwyer, Debra, Payson, Emanuel
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The Value of a Statistical Life (VSL) serves as the definitive metric for allocative efficiency in Health Economics and Benefit-Cost Analysis (BCA). However, the production and application of VSL estimates have become stratified into four distinct groups-econometric producers, practitioner appliers, scholarly supporters, and scholarly objectors-that largely operate in isolation. This paper argues that this lack of cross-disciplinary discourse has allowed foundational assumptions to persist without adequate scrutiny, compromising the scientific validity of the VSL. This study provides a critical methodological re-evaluation of the hedonic wage models used to derive VSL. The central contribution is a microeconomic examination of labor demand elasticity. Standard VSL regression analyses presume that observed wage differentials between "safe" and "risky" sectors accurately reflect the worker's risk premium. This paper demonstrates, through a partial equilibrium framework, that this equality holds true only under the highly specific condition of perfectly inelastic labor demand. By relaxing this assumption to reflect the reality of elastic labor demand, the analysis shows that observed wage differentials systematically underestimate the true compensation workers require for risk. Furthermore, the paper identifies an "information paradox" in current VSL theory. Standard models assume workers possess perfect knowledge of occupational risks to price them into their wages . Yet, regulatory agencies commission epidemiologists and engineers to identify these same risks, premised on the fact that they are unknown to the layperson. If workers already possessed the knowledge assumed by VSL producers, such expert analysis would be redundant. The analysis also challenges the "job-desperation effect, " where low-income workers with limited bargaining power accept high-risk positions at lower wages. This "missing variable" of risk awareness occasionally results in data showing negative risk premiums that defy economic intuition. The paper further critiques the assumption of risk neutrality, arguing that extrapolating small risk probabilities linearly to a full statistical life creates logical inconsistencies. If preferences were truly linear, individuals would logically accept wagers involving high probabilities of death for proportional monetary gains-a conclusion that contradicts observed human behavior. Additionally, the paper introduces the "Regulatory Indifference Paradox." If standard VSL assumptions were strictly accurate-specifically that wages perfectly compensate for risk-then workers, on average, should be economically indifferent to safety regulations. According to the model, any safety improvement would be offset by an exactly proportional reduction in wages, neutralizing the net benefit to the worker. Finally, the paper addresses the issue of false precision. It argues that the "statistical" label is a semantic shield used to deflect ethical scrutiny regarding life valuation. Moreover, the reliance on calculating the median of widely divergent study results creates an illusion of scientific consensus that masks the unreliability of the underlying estimates. The paper concludes by proposing a framework that integrates insights from behavioral economics to restore scientific integrity to the valuation of life.
abstract_zh: 统计生命价值（VSL）是健康经济学与成本效益分析（BCA）中衡量配置效率的权威指标。然而，VSL估算的生产与应用已分化为四个彼此割裂的群体——计量生产者、实践应用者、学术支持者与学术反对者。本文认为，这种跨学科对话的缺失使得基础假设未经充分审视便持续存在，损害了VSL的科学有效性。本研究对推导VSL的享乐主义工资模型进行了批判性方法论重估，核心贡献在于对劳动力需求弹性的微观经济学检验。标准VSL回归分析假定"安全"与"风险"行业间的工资差异能准确反映工人的风险溢价。本文通过局部均衡框架证明，该等式仅在劳动力需求完全无弹性这一高度特定条件下成立。放宽这一假设以反映弹性劳动力需求的现实后，分析表明观测到的工资差异会系统性低估工人实际要求的风险补偿。此外，本文指出现有VSL理论存在"信息悖论"：标准模型假设工人完全知晓职业风险以将其纳入工资定价，但监管机构却委托流行病学家与工程师识别这些风险——其前提正是外行人对这些风险一无所知。若工人真如VSL生产者假设般掌握风险信息，此类专业分析将毫无意义。分析还挑战了"求职绝望效应"——即议价能力有限的低收入工人以更低工资接受高风险岗位。这种风险认知的"缺失变量"有时会导致数据呈现违背经济学直觉的负风险溢价。本文进一步批判风险中性假设，认为将小概率风险线性外推至完整统计生命存在逻辑矛盾：若偏好确实呈线性，个体理应接受涉及高死亡概率的赌注以换取比例货币收益——这一结论与人类实际行为相悖。此外，本文提出"监管无差异悖论"：若标准VSL假设严格成立（即工资完全补偿风险），则工人平均而言应对安全监管持经济无差异态度。根据模型，任何安全改善都将被等比例工资削减所抵消，使工人的净收益归零。最后，本文探讨虚假精确性问题，指出"统计"标签实为规避生命价值伦理审视的语义盾牌。更关键的是，依赖计算差异悬殊研究结果的中位数，制造了科学共识的假象，掩盖了基础估算的不可靠性。本文最终提出融合行为经济学洞见的框架，以恢复生命价值评估的科学严谨性。

abstract: This paper studies the estimation of characteristics-based quantile factor models where the factor loadings are unknown functions of observed individual characteristics, and the idiosyncratic error terms are subject to conditional quantile restrictions. We propose a three-stage estimation procedure that is easy to implement and has nice properties. The convergence rates, the limiting distributions of the estimated factors and loading functions, plus a consistent selection criterion for the number of factors at each quantile are derived under general conditions. Our proposed estimators are shown to work satisfactorily when: (i) the idiosyncratic errors have heavy tails, (ii) the time dimension of the panel dataset is not large, and (iii) the number of factors differs from the number of characteristics. Further, a consistent estimation method based on quantile factor analysis and sieve regression is proposed when the factor loadings depend on additional unobserved characteristics. Monte Carlo simulations and an empirical application aimed at estimating the loading functions of the daily returns of a large panel of S&P 500 index securities help illustrate these properties.

abstract: We examine how political dynamics shape environmental outcomes in Colombia, focusing on the role of Regional Environmental Protection Agencies (REPAs). To identify causal effects, we implement a regression discontinuity design based on close mayoral elections. Our results show that when governors—who sit on REPA boards—are politically aligned with local mayors, annual deforestation increases by 0.044 percentage points, or about 40 percent relative to the mean. The problem is most pronounced in agencies where political actors dominate decision-making. Crucially, additional deforestation does not translate into local economic gains, suggesting that forests are being lost without broader social benefit. These findings highlight how decentralized institutional design can leave environmental governance vulnerable to political capture, underscoring the need for safeguards in the governance structure of environmental authorities to protect natural resources from short-term political interests.

title_primary: TSLS何时实际上是LATE？

When is TSLS
                    Actually
                    LATE?
authors: Christine Blandhol, John Bonney, Magne Mogstad, Alexander Torgovitsky
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Linear instrumental variable estimators, such as two-stage least squares (TSLS), are commonly interpreted as estimating non-negatively weighted averages of causal effects, referred to as local average treatment effects (LATEs). We examine whether the LATE interpretation actually applies to the types of TSLS specifications that are used in practice. We show that if the specification includes covariates—which most empirical work does—then the LATE interpretation does not apply in general. Instead, the TSLS estimator will, in general, reflect treatment effects for both compliers and always/never-takers, and some treatment effects for the always/never-takers will necessarily be negatively weighted. We show that the only specifications that have a LATE interpretation are “saturated” specifications that control for covariates nonparametrically, implying that such specifications are both sufficient and necessary for TSLS to have a LATE interpretation, at least without additional parametric assumptions. This result is concerning because, as we document, empirical researchers almost never control for covariates nonparametrically, and rarely discuss or justify parametric specifications of covariates. We apply our results to thirteen empirical studies and find strong evidence that the LATE interpretation of TSLS is far from accurate for the types of specifications actually used in practice. We offer concrete recommendations for practice motivated by our theoretical and empirical results.
abstract_zh: 线性工具变量估计量（如两阶段最小二乘法，TSLS）通常被解释为对因果效应的非负加权平均，即局部平均处理效应（LATE）。本文考察了LATE解释是否实际适用于实践中使用的TSLS设定形式。研究表明，若设定中包含协变量（多数实证研究均如此），则LATE解释通常不再适用。此时，TSLS估计量将同时反映依从者与始终/从不接受治疗者的处理效应，且始终/从不接受治疗者的部分处理效应必然被赋予负权重。我们证明，唯一具有LATE解释的设定是“饱和”设定——即通过非参数方式控制协变量，这意味着此类设定既是TSLS获得LATE解释的充分条件也是必要条件（至少在没有额外参数假设的情况下）。这一结论令人担忧，因为据我们记录，实证研究者几乎从未采用非参数方式控制协变量，且极少讨论或论证协变量的参数设定形式。我们将研究结果应用于13项实证研究，发现对于实践中实际使用的设定类型，TSLS的LATE解释远非准确。基于理论与实证结果，我们为实践操作提供了具体建议。

title: Performance of reward, punishment, and communication in common‐pool resource management: Evidence from grassland conservation in China

abstract: Common‐pool resources—such as collectively‐owned grasslands—are often overused and depleted until effective conservation strategies are put into place. We conducted a lab‐in‐the‐field experiment to examine the performance of different management strategies on the sustainability of common‐pool grassland management in China. We designed three experimental interventions—reward, punishment, and communication—to evaluate how to cost‐effectively promote grassland conservation. Results reveal that the communication treatment is as effective as the reward and punishment treatments in promoting grassland conservation. However, unlike the reward treatment, communication does not require external funding or create income inequality among herders, and unlike the punishment treatment, it avoids undesirable impacts such as reducing herders' net payoffs. A mechanism analysis suggests that our communication treatment shifts herders' focus from exploitation to conservation. Our results indicate that incorporating communication interventions into grassland management strategies could improve their overall performance.
abstract_zh: 公共池资源——例如集体所有的草原——往往因过度使用而枯竭，直至有效的保护策略得以实施。我们开展了一项实地实验室实验，考察不同管理策略对中国公共池草原管理可持续性的影响。我们设计了三种实验干预措施——奖励、惩罚和沟通——以评估如何以成本有效的方式促进草原保护。结果表明，沟通干预在促进草原保护方面与奖励和惩罚干预同样有效。然而，与奖励干预不同，沟通干预无需外部资金支持，也不会在牧民之间造成收入不平等；与惩罚干预不同，它避免了降低牧民净收益等不良影响。机制分析表明，我们的沟通干预将牧民的关注点从开发利用转向保护。研究结果表明，将沟通干预纳入草原管理策略可提升其整体绩效。

official: 官方在线 2026-05-04 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study how land market frictions affect men and women differently during structural transformation, exploiting two major Chinese land reforms that strengthened farmers' rental rights. Using large-language-model text analysis, we construct a county-level reform index and combine it with large panel data to identify causal effects. The reforms shift rural women out of agriculture more than men and reduce urban women's employment and wages relative to men. A multisector model with intra-household labor allocation rationalizes these findings: gender-neutral land market frictions act as gender-specific mobility barriers, and their removal disproportionately accelerates women's transition into non-agricultural employment.
abstract_zh: 本文研究土地市场摩擦如何在中国结构转型过程中对男性和女性产生差异化影响，利用两项强化农民租赁权的重大土地改革。通过大语言模型文本分析，我们构建了县级改革指数，并结合大规模面板数据识别因果效应。改革使农村女性比男性更大幅度地脱离农业，同时降低了城市女性相对于男性的就业率和工资。一个包含家庭内部劳动力分配的多部门模型解释了这些发现：性别中性的土地市场摩擦充当了性别特定的流动障碍，其消除不成比例地加速了女性向非农就业的转型。

abstract: The city of Dundee was renowned for its dominance in the production of jute, a coarse hard waring textile, being responsible for more than 90% of total UK output. As with other industries of the first Industrial Revolution, the industry went into decline in the twentieth century. In Dundee's case, jute production ended in 1999. This book explores the rise of the jute industry in the city of Dundee, from the initial textile stages of flax and linen in the eighteenth century into the dominance of jute from the mid-nineteenth century through to its zenith during the First World War. As such, it provides a valuable adjunct to a range of focused social and economic business histories of the jute industry and the city of Dundee. The book takes a historical approach beginning with the rise of Dundee as a co-ordinating centre for regional out-working, growing due to its existing linen export trade with England, in the decades following the Act of Union in 1707. A specialization upon coarse, rather than fine, linen fabrics encouraged the subsequent development of exporting into the Americas, providing clothing for enslaved persons, and would eventually lead to the movement into other coarse textile products made from jute. This contrasted with centres of fine linen production on the west coast of both Scotland and England where cotton textiles would then emerge. Arguably the most important thesis explored in the following chapter is the identification of the origins of the pre-eminence of Dundee with jute through colonial control of India, and specifically, the linkages between Scottish technical engineers, overseers, and managers positioned in the East India Company. The rise of British textile industries’ links with enslavement and empire provide a more central role in this history, extending our knowledge beyond cotton, first to linen and the provision of textiles during enslavement and then into jute with colonial control of India. As the authors note, ‘it is noticeable how many of the scions of Dundee's merchant families found employment in India, thereby creating a direct channel of communication between Dundee and the Far East’ (p. 75). Chapters 3 and 4 examine the fitful start of early internalization of production in the factory system alongside the ‘chaos’ of rapid urbanization. Fortunes were made and lost by entrepreneurs in an industry in which the price and quality of the raw material could fluctuate significantly. A workforce of agricultural workers and migration from Ireland proved the supply of labour in what was rapidly transforming Dundee from a regional centre into a large city. Between 1755 and 1841 Dundee's population grew from 12,477 to 62,873 and further increased to 153,587 by 1891 (table 4.1, p. 134). As with other textiles, Dundee rapidly became identified with women and child labour, earning the city the moniker as a ‘women's town’. Technical innovation in spinning and weaving facilitated improvements in the consistency of output, and new markets in carpet backing evidence an early diversity of markets for jute products. However, it was the periodic wars of the late nineteenth century and the First World War that created the huge boom in demand. Chapter 5 examines the process of rapid industrialization in the city. The failure of the city's leaders to redevelop ‘New Towns’, as occurred in Edinburgh, left a legacy of some of the worst overcrowding in housing, poor sanitation, and ill health in Scotland. Alongside this, alcoholism, prostitution, and child neglect resulted in women workers in the jute industry being particularly vilified for these social problems. Periodic unemployment, due to fluctuating economic conditions in these early decades of jute's predominance, also provided fertile ground for anti-Irish sectarianism, albeit less prevalent than on the west coast. Chapter 6 focuses upon the rise of Indian competition in global markets for jute products, notably in the low-value areas of bags, sacks, and wrappings for agricultural goods. Dundee and British machine manufacturers provided the capital equipment for the establishment of Indian mills, whilst large fortunes could be made from passive British investors in the managing agencies established to run these mills. In contrast, Dundee's jute owners themselves diverted profits to finance capital investment within the United States through the creation of investment trusts, rather than investing in the jute industry itself. The final two chapters take the story from the last quarter of the nineteenth century to the end of the First World War. Whilst the growth of the industry slowed from the rapid expansion of mid-century, absolute output continued to grow. The industry became concentrated in the hands of a few inter-connected families. The wealth generated in the city led to the opening of its own stock exchange in 1879 (p. 218). However, increasing polarization with a working class developing its own agency through trade unionism, campaigns over food availability and prices, rent strikes, and political representation are all evident. Whilst Whatley and Tomlinson reject the notion that the city was ‘on the brink of revolution’ (p. 214), it certainly became sharply divided along class lines. There are, however, some weaknesses and challenges to the narrative contained in the book. Whatley and Tomlinson are to be commended on their emphasis upon positioning Dundee's rise in the wider post-colonial historical understanding of enslavement, empire, and imperialism. Whilst they do not reject earlier historiographies highlighting Dundee's links to the whaling industry and earlier textiles, first enslavement and then empire are prioritized. However, this sits somewhat at odds with the description of the relationship between Dundee and India as ‘symbiotic’ (p. 73). No matter how low wages were driven in Dundee they were never low enough to compete with Calcutta (modern day Kolkata) on labour costs. These were far from symbiotic features of the industry, but rather a divide which pitted workers in Dundee and Kolkata against one another to the benefit of employers in both centres. One area missing from the discussion is that of employers’ management of competition and eventual cartelization within the industry. Whilst the Chamber of Commerce is highlighted as important in this area as well as the co-ordination undertaken over wage levels, the book is silent on the employers’ trade associations that emerged by the end of the period, notably the Association of Jute Spinners and Manufacturers, formally launched in 1918 after the period of consolidation and concentration between the small number of families from the 1880s onwards (p. 216). The book is in many ways a book in two halves. The first three longer chapters examining the period to the end of the nineteenth century extensively examines the rise of jute. This is very much focused upon the named entrepreneurs as individuals who constructed the city's history, and is therefore a very traditional history from above, whereas the following four chapters, in many ways more interesting, cover the social and political impact of industrialization on the city with a greater focus from below. Rapid urbanization and slum housing, moral panic arising from women as the dominant component in the industry workforce ‘neglecting’ the double burden of employment and responsibility for the household, poverty, and the rise of working-class politics form the subjects of these shorter chapters. More could have been explored in this part of the book, for this reader at least. In conclusion, the book provides an important and valuable summary of the existing literature and adds new insights into the linkages between economic, social, and political developments which made and remade Dundee as a city over two centuries.
abstract_zh: 邓迪市以生产黄麻而闻名，这是一种粗糙耐磨的纺织品，其产量占英国总产量的90%以上。与第一次工业革命中的其他行业一样，该行业在二十世纪走向衰退。就邓迪而言，黄麻生产于1999年终止。本书探讨了邓迪市黄麻产业的兴起过程，从十八世纪亚麻和亚麻布的初步纺织阶段，到十九世纪中叶黄麻的主导地位，直至第一次世界大战期间的鼎盛时期。因此，它为一系列关于黄麻产业和邓迪市的专题社会与经济商业史提供了宝贵的补充。本书采用历史研究方法，从邓迪作为区域外加工协调中心的崛起开始，这一崛起得益于其与英格兰现有的亚麻出口贸易，在1707年《联合法案》之后的几十年间得以发展。专注于粗麻布而非细麻布的生产，促进了向美洲出口的进一步发展，为被奴役者提供衣物，并最终引导产业转向由黄麻制成的其他粗纺织品。这与苏格兰和英格兰西海岸的细麻布生产中心形成对比，后者随后兴起了棉纺织品。可以说，下一章探讨的最重要论点是，通过殖民控制印度，识别出邓迪在黄麻产业中卓越地位的起源，特别是苏格兰技术工程师、监工和管理人员在东印度公司中的联系。英国纺织业与奴隶制和帝国的联系在这一历史中扮演了更为核心的角色，将我们的知识从棉花扩展到亚麻，再到奴隶制期间纺织品的供应，最后延伸到通过殖民控制印度而发展起来的黄麻产业。正如作者所指出的，“值得注意的是，邓迪商人家庭的许多后裔在印度找到了工作，从而在邓迪与远东之间建立了直接的沟通渠道”（第75页）。第三章和第四章考察了工厂制度下早期生产内部化的不稳定开端，以及快速城市化带来的“混乱”。在这个原材料价格和质量可能大幅波动的行业中，企业家们既创造了财富也遭受了损失。农业工人和来自爱尔兰的移民劳动力供应，使邓迪迅速从区域中心转变为大城市。1755年至1841年间，邓迪的人口从12,477人增长到62,873人，到1891年进一步增至153,587人（表4.1，第134页）。与其他纺织业一样，邓迪迅速与女性和童工联系在一起，赢得了“女性之城”的绰号。纺纱和织造方面的技术创新提高了产出的一致性，地毯底布等新市场则显示了黄麻产品早期市场的多样性。然而，正是十九世纪末的周期性战争和第一次世界大战创造了巨大的需求繁荣。第五章考察了该市快速工业化的过程。该市领导人未能像爱丁堡那样进行“新城”再开发，留下了苏格兰最严重的住房过度拥挤、卫生条件差和健康问题的不良遗产。与此同时，酗酒、卖淫和忽视儿童等问题导致黄麻产业中的女性工人因这些社会问题而受到特别指责。在黄麻主导地位的早期几十年中，由于经济状况波动导致的周期性失业，也为反爱尔兰宗派主义提供了土壤，尽管其程度不如西海岸严重。第六章聚焦于印度在全球黄麻产品市场上的竞争崛起，尤其是在袋、麻袋和农产品包装等低价值领域。邓迪和英国的机器制造商为印度工厂的建立提供了资本设备，而通过管理这些工厂的代理机构，被动的英国投资者可以赚取巨额财富。相比之下，邓迪的黄麻所有者则将利润转向通过创建投资信托在美国进行资本投资，而不是投资于黄麻产业本身。最后两章将故事从十九世纪最后二十五年延续到第一次世界大战结束。尽管产业增长从世纪中叶的快速扩张中放缓，但绝对产量仍在继续增长。该产业集中在少数相互关联的家族手中。该市创造的财富促使其于1879年开设了自己的证券交易所（第218页）。然而，日益加剧的两极分化，工人阶级通过工会运动、关于食品供应和价格的运动、租金罢工以及政治代表权发展出自己的能动性，这些都显而易见。尽管沃特利和汤姆林森拒绝接受该市“处于革命边缘”的观点（第214页），但它确实在阶级界限上变得尖锐分裂。然而，本书的叙述也存在一些弱点和挑战。沃特利和汤姆林森强调将邓迪的崛起置于更广泛的后殖民历史理解中，涉及奴隶制、帝国和帝国主义，这一点值得称赞。虽然他们没有拒绝早期史学强调邓迪与捕鲸业和早期纺织业的联系，但首先优先考虑了奴隶制，然后是帝国。然而，这与将邓迪与印度之间的关系描述为“共生”（第73页）有些矛盾。无论邓迪的工资被压得多低，它们都永远无法在劳动力成本上与加尔各答（现代加尔各答）竞争。这些远非该产业的共生特征，而是一种分裂，使邓迪和加尔各答的工人相互对立，从而有利于两地的雇主。讨论中缺失的一个领域是雇主对竞争的管理以及最终行业内的卡特尔化。虽然商会在这方面以及工资水平的协调中被强调为重要，但本书对这一时期末出现的雇主行业协会保持沉默，特别是黄麻纺纱和制造商协会，该协会于1918年正式成立，此前自1880年代以来少数家族之间进行了整合和集中（第216页）。本书在许多方面分为两部分。前三章较长，考察了到十九世纪末的时期，深入探讨了黄麻的兴起。这非常侧重于作为个体构建城市历史的具名企业家，因此是一种非常传统的自上而下的历史，而接下来的四章，在许多方面更有趣，涵盖了工业化对城市的社会和政治影响，更侧重于自下而上的视角。快速城市化和贫民窟住房、因女性作为产业劳动力主导成分“忽视”就业和家庭责任双重负担而引发的道德恐慌、贫困以及工人阶级政治的兴起，构成了这些较短章节的主题。至少对于这位读者而言，本书的这一部分本可以探讨更多内容。总之，本书对现有文献进行了重要而有价值的总结，并为经济、社会和政治发展之间的联系提供了新的见解，这些发展在两个世纪中塑造并重塑了邓迪这座城市。

title: Popularity in location games
title_zh: 选址博弈中的受欢迎程度
title_primary: 选址博弈中的受欢迎程度
title_secondary: Popularity in location games
authors: Gaëtan Fournier, Marc Schröder
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study spatial competition between firms when consumer choices are not only influenced by their individual preferences but also by the popularity of firms. We fully characterize the subgame perfect equilibria, and show that the preference for popular goods enlarges the classical prediction: while minimal differentiation can still occur, the set of equilibria includes differentiated and asymmetric outcomes. We also show that the welfare impact of popularity is subtle: although the socially optimal outcome is a subgame perfect equilibrium when the popularity effect is strong, the price of anarchy, which measures the worst-case outcome, varies non-monotonically with the intensity of the popularity effect.
abstract_zh: 我们研究当消费者选择不仅受个人偏好影响，还受企业流行度影响时的企业间空间竞争。我们全面刻画了子博弈完美均衡，并表明对流行商品的偏好扩展了经典预测：虽然最小差异化仍可能发生，但均衡集合包含了差异化及不对称结果。我们还表明，流行度的福利影响是微妙的：尽管当流行效应较强时，社会最优结果是子博弈完美均衡，但衡量最坏情况结果的“无政府状态代价”随流行效应强度呈非单调变化。

title: Uncovering renewable energy policy impact channels on land values, the local farm structure, and farmland heterogeneity

abstract: Abstract Germany's Renewable Energy Sources Act (REA), enacted in 2000 and subsequently amended, subsidized national renewable energy production with fixed feed‐in tariffs for renewable energy sources (RE) from wind, solar, and biogas. Empirical studies suggest that the policy was creating windfall effects for landowners and attribute farmland use homogenization to the policy. Empirical evidence, however, lacks a comprehensive and systemic analysis of the REA impact on farmland values, farm structures, and farmland heterogeneity. To understand the policy's impact channels, we propose five hypotheses, build a spatial price theory‐informed structural equation model (SEM) and test it on a rich dataset of land transactions and land uses for the Federal State of Brandenburg, 2005–2018. The SEM uncovers direct impact channels on farmland prices from an increased willingness to pay more in proximity to wind turbines and biogas plants, and on farmland heterogeneity by incentivizing maize‐based homogenous crop rotations. Indirect impact channels for biogas promotion on land prices via altering the farm structure reveal additional and larger impacts than previous studies suggested. Approximately 9% of the price increase could be attributed to the RE expansion over the study period. Future policy amendments should take such a systemic perspective and counteract adverse effects.
abstract_zh: 摘要 德国《可再生能源法》（REA）自2000年颁布并历经修订，通过为风能、太阳能及沼气等可再生能源（RE）设定固定上网电价，对国内可再生能源生产给予补贴。实证研究表明，该政策为土地所有者带来了意外收益，并将农田利用的同质化归因于此政策。然而，现有实证证据缺乏对REA影响农田价值、农场结构及农田异质性的全面系统性分析。为理解该政策的影响渠道，我们提出五项假设，构建了一个基于空间价格理论的结构方程模型（SEM），并利用勃兰登堡州2005年至2018年间丰富的土地交易与土地利用数据对其进行检验。SEM揭示了直接的影响渠道：靠近风力涡轮机和沼气厂区域的土地支付意愿增加，从而推高农田价格；同时，政策通过激励以玉米为主的同质化轮作模式，影响农田异质性。对于沼气推广通过改变农场结构间接影响土地价格的渠道，本研究发现其影响程度较以往研究更为显著且规模更大。在研究期间，约9%的价格上涨可归因于可再生能源的扩张。未来的政策修订应采取此类系统性视角，并应对不利效应加以遏制。

title: Taxation and Bank Liquidity Creation
title_zh: 税收与银行流动性创造
title_primary: 税收与银行流动性创造
title_secondary: Taxation and Bank Liquidity Creation
authors: ALLEN N. BERGER, DIMITRIS K. CHRONOPOULOS, ANNA L. SOBIECH, JOHN O.S. WILSON
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2025-11-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate the impact of taxes on bank liquidity creation using the Tokyo bank tax as a quasi‐natural experiment. Drawing on data for Japanese banks, we find that the tax reduces retained earnings and capital, leading to a significant reduction in liquidity creation. The decline in liquidity creation is concentrated on the asset‐side of bank balance sheets. Banks reduce the supply of long‐term loans and shift toward short‐term government securities. The results suggest that tax‐induced erosion of capital constraints banks’ ability to provide liquidity through productive lending, and highlight the role of capital as a risk‐absorbing buffer.
abstract_zh: 我们利用东京银行税作为准自然实验，考察税收对银行流动性创造的影响。基于日本银行的数据，我们发现该税减少了留存收益和资本，从而导致流动性创造显著下降。流动性创造的减少主要集中在银行资产负债表的资产端。银行减少了长期贷款的供给，转而投向短期政府证券。结果表明，税收引发的资本侵蚀限制了银行通过生产性贷款提供流动性的能力，并凸显了资本作为风险吸收缓冲的作用。

title: A semiparametric Bayesian estimator of copula density
title_zh: copula密度的半参数贝叶斯估计量
title_primary: copula密度的半参数贝叶斯估计量
title_secondary: A semiparametric Bayesian estimator of copula density
authors: Qiaoyu Wang, Ximing Wu, Taining Wang, Subal C. Kumbhakar, Sui Luo
official: 官方在线 2025-08-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a semiparametric Bayesian estimator for copula density, formulated as a generalized exponential family that combines a parametric baseline copula with a flexible adjustment modeled by a Gaussian Process (GP). The baseline captures the main features of dependence and accommodates possibly unbounded densities, while the GP component introduces nonparametric refinement. To modulate the influence of the baseline, we further introduce a tuning parameter that adjusts its weight in the final estimate. Both the GP hyperparameters and this tuning parameter are inferred jointly within a Bayesian framework. We also present a posterior sampler based on importance sampling, with the baseline copula serving as a natural approximating distribution. Simulations demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed estimator and the efficiency of the sampler. The method is further illustrated with an application to commodity futures markets.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种用于连接函数密度的半参数贝叶斯估计器，其形式化为广义指数族，结合了参数基线连接函数与由高斯过程（GP）建模的灵活调整项。基线部分捕捉依赖关系的主要特征，并能适应可能无界的密度，而GP成分则引入非参数细化。为了调节基线的影响，我们进一步引入一个调谐参数，以调整其在最终估计中的权重。GP超参数与该调谐参数均在贝叶斯框架内联合推断。我们还提出了一种基于重要性抽样的后验采样器，以基线连接函数作为自然的近似分布。模拟实验证明了所提估计器的有效性及采样器的效率。该方法进一步应用于商品期货市场的实例中加以说明。

title: Financial synergy support and policy incentive for China’s business innovation: based on complex systems theory
title_zh: 基于复杂系统理论的中国企业创新金融协同支持与政策激励
title_primary: 基于复杂系统理论的中国企业创新金融协同支持与政策激励
title_secondary: Financial synergy support and policy incentive for China’s business innovation: based on complex systems theory
authors: Li Fan School of Economics and Management, Tiangong University, Tianjin, China
official: 官方在线 2025-08-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Building upon the static analysis conducted via structural equation modelling (SEM), this study employs Belousov-Zhabotinskii reaction model in complex system theory to construct three-dimensional Logistic dynamic equation, simulates the collaborative support pathways between formal finance and informal finance for enterprise innovation under policy incentives. 519 science and technology-based SMEs listed on Growth Enterprise Market in China are taken as samples. The results of simulation reveal that the level of formal financial support and enterprise innovation performance improve with enhancing of policy incentive. The scale and growth rate of formal finance significantly surpass those of informal finance. Formal and informal finance consistently exhibit an incomplete substitution relationship which becomes more pronounced as policy incentives intensify. The regional disparities in the effects of policy stimulation are notable: Eastern and central regions benefit from substantial policy support, where a marked positive relationship exists between corporate innovation and formal financial support. The external policy environment in the western and northeastern regions needs to be optimized, where enterprises innovation remains sluggish. The marginal contribution of this study lies in simulating the nonlinear dynamic evolutionary pathways of financial support for enterprise innovation under different policy incentive intensities, from the perspective of complex system theory. KEYWORDS: Science and technology-based small and medium-sized enterprises financial synergistic support policy incentive complex system theory Belousov-Zhabotinskii reaction model JEL CLASSIFICATION: C15 G30 O17 O38
abstract_zh: 在结构方程模型（SEM）静态分析的基础上，本研究运用复杂系统理论中的别洛乌索夫-扎博京斯基反应模型，构建三维Logistic动态方程，模拟政策激励下正规金融与非正规金融对企业创新的协同支持路径。以中国创业板上市的519家科技型中小企业为样本。模拟结果显示：正规金融支持水平与企业创新绩效随政策激励增强而提升；正规金融的规模与增长速度显著优于非正规金融；正规金融与非正规金融始终呈现不完全替代关系，且该关系随政策激励强化而更加显著。政策激励效果存在显著区域差异：东部和中部地区受益于强有力的政策支持，企业创新与正规金融支持之间存在显著正向关系；西部和东北地区的外部政策环境有待优化，企业创新仍显滞后。本研究的边际贡献在于：从复杂系统理论视角，模拟不同政策激励强度下金融支持企业创新的非线性动态演化路径。关键词：科技型中小企业；金融协同支持；政策激励；复杂系统理论；别洛乌索夫-扎博京斯基反应模型 JEL分类号：C15 G30 O17 O38

title: ESG greenwashing and stock price crash risk: a channel analysis
title_zh: ESG漂绿与股价崩盘风险：渠道分析
title_primary: ESG漂绿与股价崩盘风险：渠道分析
title_secondary: ESG greenwashing and stock price crash risk: a channel analysis
authors: Mohammad Hendijani Zadeh Ahmad Hammami a Department of Accounting and Finance, The Deese College of Business and Economics North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University, Greensboro, USAb John Molson School of Business, Concordia University, Montreal, Canada
official: 官方在线 2025-06-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using US data from the S&P 1500 indexed firms, we offer empirical evidence concerning the impact of ESG greenwashing on firms’ risk of future stock price crash. Specifically, we show that ESG greenwashing is positively associated with firms’ risk of a future stock price crash. Our findings are robust to instrumental variable, difference-in-differences, and entropy balancing approaches. Furthermore, we identify five potential channels (mediating factors) through which ESG greenwashing can increase the risk of a future stock price crash – the degree of private corporate news hiding, financial analysts’ forecast dispersion, investment inefficiency, excessive managerial risk-taking, and equity mispricing. Our findings suggest that firms exhibiting higher levels of ESG greenwashing tend to have greater degrees of private corporate news hiding, wider financial analysts’ forecast dispersions, increased investment inefficiency, heightened managerial risk-taking, and equity mispricing, all contributing to an elevated risk of future stock price crashes.
abstract_zh: 基于标普1500指数成分企业的美国数据，本文提供了关于ESG漂绿行为对企业未来股价崩盘风险影响的实证证据。具体而言，我们发现ESG漂绿与企业未来股价崩盘风险呈正相关关系。该结论在工具变量法、双重差分法和熵平衡法下均保持稳健。进一步地，我们识别出ESG漂绿加剧未来股价崩盘风险的五个潜在渠道（中介因素）：企业私有信息隐藏程度、金融分析师预测分歧度、投资非效率性、管理层过度风险承担以及权益错误定价。研究结果表明，ESG漂绿程度较高的企业往往呈现更严重的私有信息隐藏、更宽泛的分析师预测分歧、更突出的投资非效率、更激进的管理层风险承担及更显著的权益错误定价，这些因素共同推高了未来股价崩盘风险。
